claims.text: The proposed model combines a gating mechanism with tensor products to enhance learning of long-term dependencies and improve interaction between input layers.
The architecture allows for more powerful operations in the hidden layer by integrating gating units with tensor products.
The model optimizes parameters using gradients derived from the tensor product and input values, improving learning efficiency.
